primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Independent quantitative uniform reflection estimate with actual strip observations, tested forcing, complex lower terms, exact boundary cancellation and retained coarse normal-jet errors.

source_correspondence: R0 retains a compact smooth scalar family, the strict root gap, the complete complex lower terms, fixed support enlargements and the actual coarse norm of u and its first normal derivative.
R1 performs both ordered root recursions with every parameter derivative and reimposes exact cancellation of the normal coefficient after full summation.
R2 transports one full initial operator, corrects the smoothing initial discrepancy and keeps every proper kernel error on a fixed geometric collar.
R3 writes both exact forced equations and bounds each full smoothing coefficient on u or Dx u by the coarse mixed norm. Tangential smoothing is never treated as normal smoothing.
R4 conjugates at every real Sobolev order, bounds the complete anti-Hermitian defect and proves the epsilon-regularized energy inequality in both directions.
R5 obtains an actual slice by averaging one fixed positive-width strip. Its location may depend on the input; the uniform energy bound does not.
R6 uses equality of the complete boundary tests to cancel Dx u exactly, retains the actual Dirichlet operator beta and proves both alternatives for the observed branch.

R7 uses uniformly elliptic proper parametrices, retains their smoothing normal-jet errors, subtracts the full factors and recovers the differentiated inner cutoff without asserting a supremum bound for its normal derivative.
R8 proves the displayed local estimate on one geometric neighborhood for every finite target order. The constants, not the neighborhood, may depend on order.
R9 leaves the fixed admissible observation/source interfaces, global scalar assembly, other uniform propagation regimes and the full parameter theorem open.

The three complete solutions check exact reflected modes and strip-width scaling, complex lower-term growth in both directions, and failure of boundary cancellation under principal-only initial matching.

All thirteen captures were inspected: ten overlapping desktop views, the entire exact figure and two mobile samples. Twenty-seven exact identities and 169 rendered formulas support the analytic proof review.
Fourteen entries bind to 688 earlier entries in 24 current maps, including 92 external human proofs. No internal CC0-export closure or full-course completion is asserted.
